{{Top}}
[[File:Bullseye.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker hunts rodent womp rats on Tatooine]]
{{Quote|I knew we had rodents in the hold, but I didn't know they could talk.|[[Jarael]] mocking [[Marn Hierogryph]]|<ref name="kotor4">[[Knights of the Old Republic 4|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Rodents''' were a type of animals, characterized with long sharp incisors in their mouths. The most well-known species of non-sentient rodents were [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]], [[armored rat]]s, [[rodus]]es, [[borrat]]s, [[Vrelt/Legends|vrelts]], [[Scurrier/Legends|scurriers]], [[Ollopom/Legends|ollopoms]] and many others. The sentient rodents included such species as [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fans]], [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]] and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].

[[M'iiyoom]] were known to feed on the rodents native to [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]].

Members of the [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were at times pejoratively identified with rodents, when in fact they were a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Rabbit/Legends|rabbits]].<ref name="MarvelSW8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>
